title: Weather Watchers — Build & Prepare
description: Use a weather forecast to choose useful clothing and actions, then build and test a simple shade structure for an ice cube.
learningFocus: Use weather information to discuss how people can prepare for changing or severe weather.
Build, test, and observe a simple structure intended to reduce warming from sunlight.
adultGuidance: Talk through why each forecast choice helps before your child circles it. For the shade test, use matching ice cubes and trays in the same area, change only whether a cube is shaded, and record the real outcome even when the first design does not work as expected.
